# Reviewed feats #344

Exactly 100 byte-exact pf1-content 11.4.0 candidates from #344. `provenance.json` pins the source paths, hashes and exact ticket-order key digest. All 100 candidates remain held; no fixture establishes global admission.

`comparison-sources/` contains 92 permitted PCGen snapshots at `25523dbcf10e86c280fc0f447167ea43d67419d3`. `supporting-sources/` contains 22 pinned YAML snapshots. Seven PCGen snapshots also serve as inherited-rule evidence. The legal inventory records every cited location and hash; none is an additional candidate. No book PDF or Archives of Nethys evidence is used.

`preview.json` retains complete-source normalized bodies after final review. Reduced manifests retain only the candidate pack and an empty system pack directory. Reduced imports reproduce mechanics; complete-source bodies preserve actual prerequisite keys and content bindings. These reduced fixtures do not replace complete-source release evidence.

`sheet.ts` adapts the explicitly held Pass For Human, Opening Volley and Defended Movement bodies for isolated public resolver and saved-sheet tests. It preserves rule identity, Sources, Modifiers and Notes, omitting `repeatable: unreviewed` without inventing a replacement. Local Situation selection is manual and scoped to the sheet entry. No Catalog Release, production deployment or hold clearance occurs.

The inventory is `scripts/catalog/legal/feats-344.json`, the report is `docs/catalog-import/feats-344.md`, and the tests are `tests/catalog/feats-344.test.ts` and `convex/feats344.integration.test.ts`.

`data.ts` reads bounded snapshots through schemas to keep the lint server from inferring a distinct type for every JSON row. The shared #343 preservation correction was reviewed for #526 (commit `3bdf2e67`) and reused verbatim: `../feats-343/original-assessment-identities.json` pins the immutable 2,334-key baseline, full-row fingerprint and 99 trailing-space rationales. Its tests reject missing identities and trimmed values while allowing later additions. No duplicate #344 baseline fixture is retained.
